title: Mem2A extension params
description: The `params` object of the Mem2A entry in a memory's Agent Card (`capabilities.extensions[]`).

listen.description: How agents can receive updates while a task is open: `push` (A2A push notifications) and/or `subscribe` (A2A SubscribeToTask).

watchTimeoutSeconds.description: How long memory keeps a task open waiting for a commit. Omitted means memory does not expire watches on its own.

entityTypes.description: Optional hint: entity types memory knows about, for example `account`, `project`, `doc`.
